questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I haven't seen him for years,' she said.
options: She said she hadn't seen him for years.

She said she doesn't see him for years.
She said that she hasn't seen him for years.
